versions.description: A savings bank that gives currency a reason to be saved. Players move currency between their wallet and a separate bank balance with bank deposit and bank withdraw. Bank balances earn interest on a schedule (daily by default), with a configurable rate, a cap per payout and a minimum balance. VIP roles can earn a higher rate. An optional withdraw fee and balance cap keep the economy in check. Admins see totals and top savers with bankstats.

commands.name: bank
commands.description: Check your bank balance, or deposit and withdraw currency.
commands.helpText: bank: show your bank balance and next interest. bank deposit <amount|all>: move currency from your wallet into the bank. bank withdraw <amount|all>: move currency from the bank to your wallet.

commands.name: bankstats
commands.description: Admin: show the total held in the bank and the top savers.
commands.helpText: Shows the number of bank accounts, the total held, the interest paid so far and the top savers.

cronJobs.name: payInterest
cronJobs.description: Pays interest on every bank balance that meets the minimum.

functions.name: bank-helpers

permissions.description: Earn a higher interest rate in the bank. The count is the interest rate in percent (for example 3 = 3%). It is only used when it is higher than the normal rate.
Allows using the bankstats command to see the total held in the bank and the top savers.
